title: Trajectory Coherence and Early Transition Detection
original_formulation: T × E = Et ~ F ± e = A|M
reason_for_primary_classification: The trajectory-dynamics score strongly discriminated terminal A/M at step 12 (AUC 0.9548), but improved over F-only by only 0.0264 rather than the preregistered 0.05 and over the best E/F/e single variable by only 0.0264 rather than 0.03. The valid primary hypothesis is therefore FALSIFIED.
reason_for_early_warning_classification: At step 6, only 25% through the trajectory, the frozen trajectory-dynamics score achieved AUC 0.9056, exceeding the preregistered 0.70 early-warning criterion. The early-warning subclaim is therefore SUPPORTED.
interpretation: EFGM-inspired trajectory measurements contain strong information about eventual A/M before the terminal state in this synthetic environment.
The preregistered stronger claim that the frozen trajectory-dynamics score adds large incremental predictive value beyond contemporaneous Flow alone was not supported.

A simple current-state joint comparator using E, Et, F and entropy complement outperformed the frozen trajectory-dynamics score at all three checkpoints; this is descriptive evidence only and was not a preregistered rescue criterion.
Any follow-on test of state coupling versus trajectory-history features must be preregistered as a new experiment rather than modifying EXP-0010.
claim_boundary: Synthetic deterministic trajectory evidence only. This result does not falsify the historical EFGM expression as a universal theory and does not change EFGM v1, EFGM v2, Agent Governance v0.3, AE/CUE, EXP-0008, or any frozen baseline.
immutability_rule: Do not alter the frozen coefficients, trajectory factors, terminal label rule, checkpoints, comparators, or success criteria to convert this result into SURVIVED. Any revised operationalization must be a new experiment.
